records.decision: Restrict MCP SQL query tools against the default cache to read-only queries.
records.reason: Agents querying cached data must not be able to modify the cache.

records.decision: Do not depend on PyArrow or Parquet for writing records; use JSONL file writers for local staging.
records.reason: PyArrow and Parquet cannot handle ragged, conflicting, or empty-object JSON schemas.

records.decision: Cover explicit `workspace_id` routing in cloud MCP tools with parametrized unit tests that assert `_get_cloud_workspace` receives the non-default workspace.
records.reason: Signature-only regressions can break hosted client-credential workflows.

records.decision: Monkeypatch `get_source` and other registry/network calls in cloud MCP unit tests so they never hit external services.
records.reason: Real registry/network/installation paths make unit tests slow, flaky, and externally dependent.

records.decision: Mark MCP tools that trigger reads or writes against external customer systems (e.g. `run_cloud_sync`) with `open_world=True` and include them in the package-wide open-world allowlist.
records.reason: Clients rely on `openWorldHint` to restrict tools that touch external data.

records.decision: Gate the cloud-mcp dispatch CI step on whether the package resolves with uv, not on its presence in the HTML simple index.
In MCP mode, honor an upstream `X-Airbyte-Analytic-Source` header only when its value is on the allowlist.
In `_build_schema`, treat an `input_schema` dict as a pre-built JSON Schema whenever its `type` value is a string; do not also require a `properties` key.
records.reason: `properties` is optional in JSON Schema, and a `{name: python_type}` mapping never has a string-valued `type`.

records.decision: Parse inline settings JSON strictly and raise a `ValueError` that identifies the inline settings string when it is malformed; never silently drop it or fall back to treating it as a file path.
records.reason: Silently discarding malformed settings made broken runs look healthy.

records.decision: When a settings file is missing, keep the documented degradation: log a warning and continue with sandbox-only settings.
records.reason: This missing-file behavior is documented.

records.decision: Call `_build_command()` inside the `try` block in `connect()` so that command-building errors stay within the `ClaudeSDKError` hierarchy and set `_exit_error`.
records.reason: Errors raised outside the `try` escaped the SDK error hierarchy.

records.decision: When forking sessions, remap compaction metadata references (preservedSegment, preservedMessages, runningTurnSends UUIDs) with the same old-to-new UUID mapping used for copied messages.
records.reason: Compaction metadata otherwise points at source IDs that do not exist in the fork.

records.decision: In fork metadata, trim IDs that were excluded from the fork, and drop a metadata block whose anchor, opener, or segment endpoint was excluded; never pull excluded messages into the fork or guess replacement endpoints.
When a fork's cutoff is a compact boundary, end the fork just before that boundary.
records.reason: Resuming a fork that kept the boundary without its preserved blocks lost the earlier compaction summaries.

records.decision: Do not validate fork metadata IDs with a blanket UUID-shaped-string validator; preserve absent IDs, malformed values, and uninterpreted fields in retained blocks.
records.reason: Historical running-turn bookkeeping can legitimately outlive transcript records.

records.decision: When forking, copy any metadata containers you change and never mutate source entries or message content.
SDK MCP `call_tool` handlers must return a `CallToolResult` with `isError` taken from the tool result's `is_error` field, not a bare content list.
records.reason: A bare list gets wrapped with `isError=False`, which silently drops tool errors.

records.decision: In fast-path session listing, filter out sidechain and empty summaries before applying offset/limit so they never consume page slots.
records.reason: This matches the slow path's filter-then-paginate behavior.

records.decision: `list_sessions_from_store()` must filter the full listing first and then paginate it with `_apply_sort_limit_offset()`, so `limit`/`offset` index the filtered set exactly as on the disk path.
records.reason: This keeps store and disk paths consistent and stops sidechains from consuming page slots.

records.decision: In e2e CI, give the e2e user read-only access to the checkout and deny it writes to runner directories (on macOS: its own group, not `staff`; on Windows: no write access to the work root, toolcache, or runner directory), and kill its processes after the tests finish.
records.reason: This isolates the sandboxed e2e user from the CI runner.

records.decision: Hide SpatiaLite system tables from the default table listings.
records.reason: SpatiaLite system tables clutter the interface and are not user data.

records.decision: Compute facet counts against the pre-pagination SQL and parameters (`from_sql` / `from_sql_params`), not the query with `_next` cursor conditions applied.
records.reason: Including cursor conditions makes facet counts on later pages cover only rows after the cursor.

records.decision: Strip `_next` from facet value links that select or deselect a value, but preserve other query arguments including repeated ones; keep `_next` on links that remove a whole facet.
records.reason: Changing the selected value changes the row set, so carrying the cursor skips matching rows.

records.decision: Instrument significant user actions (login, logout, token creation, write API operations) by calling `datasette.track_event()` so plugins can observe them, and document each core event.
records.reason: Provides a uniform mechanism for analytics and plugins to receive events.

records.decision: Treat a database file as immutable when `inspect-data.json` is present and lists that file.
Parse the query string with keep_blank_values=True when building export/CSV forms from table view filters so blank-value filters like ?name= are preserved.
records.reason: Dropping blank values causes exports to ignore filters such as name = "" and return unfiltered rows.

records.decision: Build request-derived export URLs (table, row, query JSON/CSV links) from the router-stripped route_path rather than the full request path, so base_url is not applied twice.
records.reason: Using the full path double-prefixes base_url in export links.

records.decision: Do not change the behavior of urls.path() when fixing base_url handling for derived links.
In json_schema_to_type, treat oneOf the same as anyOf (produce a Union) and do not enforce oneOf exclusivity.
records.reason: Matches the triage direction; exclusivity enforcement was intentionally left out.

records.decision: In json_schema_to_type, convert allOf by merging members into a single schema (merge properties, concatenate required, resolve $ref with cycle protection, apply sibling constraints conjunctively) before conversion.
records.reason: Composed objects should come back as real dataclasses instead of typing.Any, per JSON Schema 2020-12 semantics.

records.decision: Azure provider token verification must accept both the bare client_id GUID and the identifier_uri as valid audiences.
records.reason: Azure v2 tokens use the bare GUID for default api://{guid} URIs while custom identifier URIs use the URI form; accepting only one breaks the other.

records.decision: Use FastMCP types (Message, PromptResult) internally for prompts and convert to MCP SDK types only at the protocol boundary.
records.reason: Keeps prompts consistent with the resources pattern of FastMCP types internally, SDK types at the boundary.

records.decision: Prompt functions must return str, Message, list[Message], or PromptResult; returning mcp.types.PromptMessage directly is no longer supported.
records.reason: Message is now the canonical prompt message type (breaking change).

records.decision: When aggregating scope shortfalls across the middleware chain, walk from after the raising AuthMiddleware and stop (break) at the first AuthMiddleware whose scope_requirements returns None; skip non-AuthMiddleware entries without stopping.
records.reason: Scopes behind an unevaluated opaque gate must never be disclosed; non-auth middleware like the auto-appended DereferenceRefsMiddleware is not a gate.

records.decision: An opaque (non-scope) authorization check that fails must raise a plain AuthorizationError that names no scopes.
records.reason: Opaque denials must disclose nothing about required scopes.

records.decision: Prioritize non-disclosure over completeness when reporting scope shortfalls, accepting partial reported sets that may require multiple rounds.
records.reason: The disclosure property outranks completeness.

records.decision: Fix conformance fixture gaps in the fixture server.py instead of baselining scenarios in expected-failures.yml.
records.reason: Baselining drops regression coverage on paths that are actively shipped.

records.decision: Keep supporting the handshake-era sampling wire path even though the public authoring API was removed.
records.reason: The proxy provider relay depends on it.

records.decision: Make proxy protocol policy explicit (`independent` or `mirror`) rather than implicitly forwarding frontend connection state to the backend.
records.reason: Frontend and backend connections can negotiate different protocol eras independently.

records.decision: Keep proxy client factories request-independent.
records.reason: Backend connections must not depend on per-request frontend state.

records.decision: When a proxy forwards a request, rebuild or omit connection-owned reserved `_meta` fields (e.g. `io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion`, `clientInfo`, `clientCapabilities`) for the backend connection while preserving progress, tracing, task, and application metadata.
records.reason: Forwarding frontend connection metadata wholesale makes it disagree with the backend session.

records.decision: In sampling handlers, resolve a tool result's function name by matching its `tool_use_id` to the paired `ToolUseContent.name`; never derive the function name by parsing the ID.
records.reason: MCP sampling carries ID and name separately and matches results to calls by ID (SEP-1577); IDs are opaque.

records.decision: Do not add a shared sizing/serialization utility layer; let each middleware size results itself (e.g. model_dump_json / pydantic_core.to_json).
records.reason: The few remaining call sites each need different behavior, so a common layer isn't worth it without a concrete consumer.

records.decision: Do not validate or stringify values returned by scrubbing callbacks inside Logfire; pass callback results through as returned.
records.reason: Callback value validation and stringification were deliberately removed from Logfire.

records.decision: In scrubbing tests, ignore only the arbitrary object representation in exported fields and still assert all other exported fields.
records.reason: The object representation varies by OpenTelemetry version.

records.decision: When a pydantic-ai test needs tools disabled, set `model_settings={'tool_choice': 'none'}` on the Agent instead of asking the model in the prompt not to use tools.
records.reason: Prompt-level instructions may be ignored by the model, so the test outcome would not be deterministic.

records.decision: Use the `ui.resolve` span op for Ember component definition lookup spans, not `function` or `ui.render`.
records.reason: `function` loses the component name and `ui.render` would collide with the following render span.

records.decision: Apply span ops regardless of the trace lifecycle; only span names are gated on span streaming.
records.reason: Ops are not gated on span streaming, unlike names.

records.decision: When span streaming is enabled, name Ember route hook spans after the hook (e.g. `beforeModel`, `model`) and put the route on `sentry.description`; in the static lifecycle keep the route as the span name and omit `sentry.description`.
records.reason: This follows the `function` op's `{{code.function.name}}` name template, and in the static lifecycle the attribute would only duplicate the name, matching `@sentry/angular`'s `TraceMethod`.

records.decision: Replace the hard-coded `ui.resolve` op string with the imported constant once getsentry/sentry-conventions#633 lands.
records.reason: The op is hard-coded with a TODO until the convention constant is available.

records.decision: Keep `enableComponentDefinitions` enabled in the `ember-classic` E2E app.
records.reason: It is the only coverage of the `ui.resolve` code path in CI.

records.decision: In the LangChain integration, default `enableTruncation` to `false` when span streaming is enabled, unless the user explicitly set it.
When transport sending fails, `sendEnvelope` must resolve with an empty object, not with the rejection reason.
records.reason: The result must match the `TransportMakeRequestResponse` type.

records.decision: In the server-runtime-injection hook build, resolve `debug` directly to its Node entry (`debug/src/node.js`) so the browser build is not bundled.
records.reason: The bundled browser build touches `localStorage`, which emits an ExperimentalWarning on Node versions that have Web Storage enabled.

records.decision: Make sure loading the hook bundle writes nothing to stderr, or at least that the built hook does not contain `localStorage`, and assert this in `test/hook.test.ts`.
records.reason: This prevents warnings on every cold start.

records.decision: Once Sentry Conventions ships metric names, define BFCache metric names there rather than ad hoc in the SDK.
records.reason: Standardize metric names across SDKs.

records.decision: Use the `SENTRY_OP` constant from `@sentry/conventions/attributes` instead of the `sentry.op` string literal or the deprecated core constant.
records.reason: Align with the shared Sentry conventions package; the core constant is deprecated.

records.decision: Keep the deprecated core `sentry.op` constant exported, including SDK re-exports, for backward compatibility.
records.reason: Avoid breaking public API consumers.

records.decision: Save the WebKit system package installer cache only on develop and restore it on PR runs.
records.reason: Avoid slow Ubuntu mirror downloads in CI.

records.decision: Put shared E2E test application preparation steps in `.github/actions/prepare-e2e-test` instead of duplicating them in build.yml and optional-e2e.yml.
records.reason: Prevent the two workflows from drifting apart.

records.decision: Keep Playwright installation, building and test running in the workflows rather than in the composite action.
records.reason: Playwright installs as a background step, and composite actions cannot declare background steps.

records.decision: Route in-app support through the structured Support Form drawer backed by `plainRouter` instead of the removed plain in-app chat (`PlainChat`).
records.reason: Structured tickets with metadata improve support quality and resolution speed.

records.decision: Gate in-app support UI behind the `in-app-support` entitlement, which is enabled for all cloud plans including hobby.
records.reason: Entitlement was agreed to be available on all cloud plans.

records.decision: Do not put aggregate expressions in events table column `internal` definitions; `getEventsNumericStatsByFilterColumn` wraps them in min/max/avg/count and nested aggregates break ClickHouse.
records.reason: Aggregate inside aggregate is a ClickHouse error that breaks the numeric filter range.

records.decision: Compute trace-level tool call counts by counting TOOL-type spans (`countIf(type = 'TOOL')`) rather than reading per-event `tool_calls` arrays.
records.reason: tool_calls arrays only exist on GENERATION spans, so CHAIN/SPAN rows show zero.

records.decision: Do not branch truncation logic on table names; fix or directly detect the root cause of incompatibility instead.
records.reason: Table-name opt-outs hide the real incompatibility and are fragile.

records.decision: Do not include caller-supplied IDs (e.g. `eventBodyId`) in queue job failure logs; identify jobs only by `projectId` and BullMQ `jobId`.
records.reason: Caller-supplied IDs should not leak into logs; the failed set retains the full payload for replay.

records.decision: Create organization API keys via the Admin API with `createdBy: "system"` and no creator record, without looking up an org member.
records.reason: Orgs may have no members, so a creator lookup must not be required.

records.decision: Take a transaction-scoped advisory lock on owner and provider before reading the existing LLM connection in create/upsert operations.
records.reason: Ensures adapter checks see the row the write replaces under concurrent upserts.

records.decision: In time-series widget charts, represent missing buckets as 0 for additive metrics (count/uniq/sum) and as null (visible gap) for non-additive metrics (avg/min/max/percentiles); never coerce missing non-additive values to 0.
records.reason: Filling gaps with fabricated values misrepresents data that was never measured.

records.decision: Keep connectNulls defaulted to false on line and area charts so null buckets break the line instead of bridging it.
records.reason: Bridging gaps fabricates values that were never measured.

records.decision: Use linear interpolation for time-series line and area charts, not monotone/bezier smoothing.
records.reason: Smoothing implies unsampled values and can overshoot between real points.

records.decision: Render isolated data points (null on both sides) as visible dots on line and area charts so real data is never hidden by gaps.
records.reason: Without connectNulls, isolated points span no segment and would be invisible.

records.decision: Treat query gap-fill placeholder rows as bucket markers rather than an 'n/a' series, accepting the zero-valued form only for additive aggregations.
records.reason: Placeholder rows otherwise create phantom series, while real dimension-less zeros for avg/percentiles must remain data points.
